scope: Research only, no candidate review/ranking or production edits.
requirements: four configurable fields with full labels

sources.title: Stachoň et al. — Effect of Size, Shape and Map Background in Cartographic Visualization
sources.source_findings: 69 Czech/Chinese GIS/cartography students, 48 tasks; target among 24 distractors; 6–13 px stimuli on 22-inch monitors. Larger symbols and absence of map background improved search speed in their task.
sources.spacefox_inference: Test rendered marker size and background competition separately; use size/shape redundancy for launchpoint.
sources.limits: Not wrist, predominantly young trained map readers; differing physical pixel size means 6–13 px is not a Garmin threshold; medium sizes excluded from part of analysis.
sources.new_reason: New empirical study specifically manipulates point-symbol size, shape and map background.

sources.title: Cybulski & Ledermann — The impact of point symbol similarity on visual search on maps
sections_read: TU Wien primary repository metadata and abstract; full article not obtained
sources.source_findings: Abstract reports 33 participants and 60 stimuli, poorer search with greater similarity between target and distractors; round-based symbols reportedly easiest within tested sets.
sources.spacefox_inference: Make launchpoint distinct from stars, status dots, decorative orbit objects; do not assume round shape universally wins.
sources.limits: Abstract-only evidence: effect sizes, exact stimuli and full limitations not independently examined. Supplemental code repository readme inspected only for access, not executed.
sources.new_reason: New point-symbol similarity and visual-search question, not a general watch-face review.

sources.title: Li, Newman & Klasnja — Exploring the Design Space of Glanceable Smartwatch Feedback Displays: Experimental Study
sources.source_findings: 202 retained MTurk participants; desktop watch simulation shown for 5 s, followed by progress/time recall. Stylization harmed progress estimation; significant salience effect was not found.
sources.spacefox_inference: Use an actual launch-marker detection question; test both primary time and marker rather than borrowing progress-estimation results.
sources.limits: Not a worn watch or marker-search task; design dimensions partly confounded; trained interpretation, recall delay and 5 s exposure differ from uncued 1 s findability.
sources.new_reason: New 2026 primary glance study and important counterexample to universal salience claims.

sources.title: Zhang et al. — Designing Effective Multi-Window Map Interfaces: The Role of Highlighting and Luminance Contrast in Visual Search
sources.source_findings: 35 university students, 21.5-inch monitor at 60 cm, abstract-letter target search across a dense 16-window layout. Highlighting and contrast interacted; region-based emphasis helped in tested conditions.
sources.spacefox_inference: In G3 test one coherent selected-launch region and quiet supporting map, not uniformly brighter everything.
sources.limits: Not marker identity or wrist context; highlights differ in spatial extent; chromaticity not independently controlled; medium/high contrast plateau is not a Garmin prescription. Reference-only correction reported.
sources.new_reason: New primary experiment on spatial organization of attention rather than earlier chart reading.

sources.title: Ordnance Survey — Symbology
sources.source_findings: Symbols may encode with size, shape, color, lightness, orientation and pattern; hierarchy separates key figure from supporting ground.
sources.spacefox_inference: Reserve a distinctive marker identity for launchpoint; mute basemap features without deleting mandatory information.
sources.limits: Practice guidance, not user experiment; attempted GitBook illustration download was denied and is NOT counted as visual inspection.
sources.new_reason: New cartographic symbology and figure-ground source.

sources.title: Esri — Cartographic creations: Style thematic data
sources.date: Tutorial last tested 2026-07-16; publication date not specified
sources.source_findings: Tutorial lowers park fill contrast to retain mountain foreground; adds boundary for context; cautions that shadows on multiple layers confuse hierarchy.
sources.spacefox_inference: Quiet land and graticule while keeping selected launch marker prominent; selected-place label should belong to the marker region.
sources.limits: Tutorial demonstration, not measured UX; desktop map and many mountain symbols; specific colors/shadow widths not watch norms.
sources.new_reason: New foreground/background cartographic example with inspectable visual.

visual_inspection.section: Map at two different scales after pale fill/dark outline
visual_inspection.method: view_image on official asset; NASA PDF rendered with bundled pdftoppm
visual_inspection.observed: Two scale views: pale park fill and dark outline, dark/green mountain triangles stand above subdued basemap; some triangles are cut by image boundaries.

sources.title: Mapbox — Optimize map label placement
sources.source_findings: Alternative anchors are tried in order; if none fits, label can be hidden; collision settings control visibility and overlaps.
sources.spacefox_inference: Critical full launch-site caption needs an explicit fallback outside map with a truthful leader; optional map labels can yield, mandatory caption cannot disappear.
sources.limits: Technical behavior, not legibility study; invisible-by-collision fallback is unacceptable as SpaceFox completion. CSS/GL units are not Garmin physical pixels.
sources.new_reason: New selected-object labeling and collision placement behavior.

sources.title: Mapbox Style Specification — circle stroke and text halo
sources.source_findings: Circle stroke lies outside circle radius. Text halo expands from font outline; documented maximum is 1/4 font size in this renderer.
sources.spacefox_inference: Measure complete outer rendered support including stroke/halo in clipping checks; core radius alone does not describe visibility.
sources.limits: Mapbox-specific implementation contract, not a Garmin halo optimum or minimum size. Geometric bounds must be verified in final PNG after every mask.
sources.new_reason: New precise rendered-bounds and halo behavior, separate from previous typography guides.

sources.title: Google Maps — Advanced marker parts/customization and collision management
sections_read: Marker collision management: REQUIRED and REQUIRED_AND_HIDES_OPTIONAL
sources.source_findings: Marker border, glyph and background are separate style components; required marker can hide optional overlapping labels. A title property is not a persistent visible caption.
sources.spacefox_inference: Keep a required launchpoint above optional map decoration; change core/border/glyph independently in G1. Full site name remains visibly rendered.
sources.limits: Google platform capability, not Garmin result; do not enable paid API/sample runtime. No code from external example executed.
sources.new_reason: New marker anatomy and prioritization rather than Wear OS style guides.

visual_inspection.section: Figure 1: Parts of an Advanced Marker
visual_inspection.method: view_image on official asset; NASA PDF rendered with bundled pdftoppm
visual_inspection.observed: Yellow pin background, red boundary and blue central glyph separately labeled; the geographic anchor is suggested by the pin tip, not by label arrows.

sources.title: W3C — Understanding WCAG 2.2: Non-text Contrast (1.4.11)
sources.date: WCAG 2.2 understanding document; exact page date not specified
sources.source_findings: Significant graphical information has 3:1 contrast to adjacent colors under this criterion; identification depends on essential shape parts rather than every decorative color.
sources.spacefox_inference: Check marker contour against the actual adjacent land/ocean/coast pixels; clear identity and outline matter more than average image contrast.
sources.limits: Web criterion, not a wrist minimum or proof of noticeability. Nominal pass does not resolve tiny strokes, anti-aliasing, glare or competing glyphs.
sources.new_reason: New non-text/essential-shape criterion; prior ledger covered use-of-color and text contrast only.

visual_inspection.method: view_image on official asset; NASA PDF rendered with bundled pdftoppm
visual_inspection.observed: Red U-shaped magnet with white tips and black outline: recognizable object requires shape and differentiated tips, not red hue alone.

sources.title: NASA — Human Integration Design Processes, NASA/TP-2014-218556
sources.source_findings: Guidance distinguishes physical/angular dimensions and environmental conditions; standards do not replace representative testing; shown identification test already cues the target.
sources.spacefox_inference: Record physical screen diameter, viewing distance/angle, rendered core/halo. Add uncued launchpoint search; do not call cued recognition a findability test.
sources.limits: Historical aerospace manual, not current Garmin requirement or current NASA compliance audit. Its 1 s/98% and font angles are not adopted as SpaceFox norms; font legibility is not point-marker detection.
sources.new_reason: New ergonomics/evaluation source with explicit distinction between legibility and search.

visual_inspection.method: view_image on official asset; NASA PDF rendered with bundled pdftoppm
visual_inspection.observed: Orange box surrounds a small green schematic symbol in a dense procedures display; caption and text explicitly say cued element and highlighting.

sources.title: Atilgan, Xiong & Legge — Reconciling print-size and display-size constraints on reading
sections_read: Selected full-text Results, Discussion and Materials/Methods excerpts via Europe PMC XML mirror
sources.source_findings: 30 normally sighted and 10 low-vision participants read prose at simulated laptop/tablet/phone formats on one 27-inch monitor. Font size and characters per line jointly constrained reading speed.
sources.spacefox_inference: Do not make full site captions unreadably narrow to fund a larger marker; reflow or allocate a larger caption zone and test it.
sources.limits: Prose reading over 1-minute tasks, not wrist search or short labels. Reported character-count thresholds are not minimum label length or a safe small-font prescription. Full sections/data not reanalyzed.
sources.new_reason: New primary physical/display-size constraint study, not a repeated watch-face survey.

hypotheses.contrast: 8/12/16 px; identical halo and other UI
hypotheses.test: Uncued 1 s view, indicate launchpoint position; then HH:MM probe on separate trials
hypotheses.criterion: At least90% detection, localization error≤10px; selected size improves vs8px by≥5pp; HH:MM loss≤3pp

hypotheses.contrast: single accent fill vs same core with crisp light/dark contours
hypotheses.test: Matched land/ocean/coast/graticule conditions; final PNG clipping and user search
hypotheses.criterion: Detection errors reduced≥20%; HH:MM loss≤3pp; no essential contour clipping

hypotheses.contrast: unique shape plus explicit launch-site relation vs similar shape/color used by decor
hypotheses.test: Uncued1s: what is marked and where; full place/country preserved
hypotheses.criterion: Incorrect object identity reduced≥20%; no unverified coordinate displacement

hypotheses.contrast: launch-centered geo window vs global window, same accepted G1 marker
hypotheses.test: Truthful coordinate projection at coast/dateline/limb fixtures; uncued marker search
hypotheses.criterion: Zero clipped/hidden essential marker parts and zero anchor displacement; localization time improves≥15% without losing country/site reading>3pp

hypotheses.contrast: full external caption with short truthful leader vs same full caption visually detached from point
hypotheses.test: 2s: associate marked place with complete country/site; long-name and edge fixtures
hypotheses.criterion: Wrong place-to-marker association≤5% and at least20% fewer errors vscontrol; no glyph or halo clipping

hypotheses.contrast: quiet land/coast/graticule and one selected-launch region vs equal emphasis of all layers
hypotheses.test: Uncued1s marker and separate HH:MM/field probes; mandatory content identical
hypotheses.criterion: Marker detection improves≥5pp; time/field accuracy loss≤3pp; geography and all full labels retained

hypotheses.contrast: one consistent launch accent linking marker and full caption vs same palette accents spread across decoration
hypotheses.test: Switch three missions with different country/site lengths;2s identify selected site and countdown state
hypotheses.criterion: Incorrect contextual attribution reduced≥20%; no field movement/clipping; exact required text remains readable

geometric_inferences.physical_marker_size: s_mm = rendered_px * physical_screen_diameter_mm /390; viewing angle = 2*atan(s_mm/(2*distance_mm)). Record actual device values; no nominal diameter assumed.
geometric_inferences.circular_window_support: For a circular marker support radius m in a circular geo window radius r: distance(marker center, window center)+m≤r. Apply to stroke and essential halo, not core alone.
geometric_inferences.edge_policy: Recenter/choose projection or allocate external caption; never clamp a marker to screen edge while retaining original location claim.
geometric_inferences.draw_order: Validate finalPNG after map mask/globe horizon and screen mask, basemap, overlays and labels. Scene-graph presence alone is not visibility.
